title: create_invite input
description: Board owners: create an invite link. audience 'link' lets any signed-in person join; 'email' one verified address; 'domain' verified addresses at one company domain.

value.description: Email address or domain, for those audiences

join_by.description: RFC 3339 time after which the link stops working. Default: 7 days for link and domain invites.

access_ends_at.description: RFC 3339 time when memberships created by this invite end
